turns.prompt: Why do conflict retries spike after midnight UTC?

items.text: Every device token expires at midnight UTC, so clients reconnect at once and retry the writes they queued. I only read files; nothing changed.

turns.prompt: Rotate sync tokens without signing devices out

items.text: Devices now keep their previous token for an hour after rotation, so a write in flight during rotation succeeds instead of failing with a conflict. The store tests pass.

turns.prompt: Explain sync conflicts in the sync guide

items.text: The sync guide now explains that when two devices edit the same note offline, both versions are kept and the newer one opens first.

turns.prompt: Fix the broken links in the getting-started guide

items.text: Three links pointed at renamed pages. They now point at the current paths.

turns.prompt: Explain how harbor picks a template for each page

items.text: Every page uses `templates/page.html`. `Site.Build()` parses all templates in `templates/` and executes `page.html` with the page's title and rendered body. I only read files; nothing changed.
